title: Pan-Seared Shrimp with Mediterranean Curry Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic French-inspired dish with succulent shrimp and a rich, spicy Mediterranean curry sauce. Perfect for a quick and elegant dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute, until the sauce thickens.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the olives and parsley to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
